audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 with 51.08% over 601 games: Talon owns the lane phases, Veigar's infinite scaling and cage-execute threat keep the game rating honest.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart reads Talon x3, Skill x2, Veigar x2 while content win[] and packet levelChart read Talon on all seven rows.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-grounded (20s Event Horizon rank 1 gaps, lethality through paper health, stack denial); full rows 3-6 are the stale side.
audit.corrected: phases[3-6].side moved to Talon with matching whys and ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content calls Talon's R 'Bladeflurry' in whys[4] and spikes[1].text — real name Shadow Assault. spikes[0] states cage cooldown as '~16-18s'; the kit says 20s at rank 1. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two pasted trade-string bullets.
audit.why: Kit numbers: E 20/18.5/17/15.5/14, R 120/90/60 missing-health execute, Q 6s rank 1. Edge-only cage stun already correctly stated.
audit.corrected: Names and the cooldown figure fixed, cooldowns field numbered, bullets rewritten to their titles.

audit.why: Most punishable cooldown is Event Horizon (20s rank 1) — now numbered in breakdown.cooldowns and phases[3].why.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Assassin's Path for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Event Horizon: 20s at rank 1 — only the cage EDGE stuns; hold near the center or leave before it forms, never dash into the wall. Every downtime is a free all-in. - Primordial Burst: 120s at rank 1, a missing-health execute — don't linger low. - Your R: 100s, kills only.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: Once cage and Dark Matter are spent he has nothing for you — that 20-second silence is your Q window; take it every time.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: Diving without knowing where the cage will land is a coin-flip — bait Event Horizon out, then commit.

edits.before: Bleed-string the contacts: W both passes, Q the gap, auto the third stack. The lane bleeds rent.
edits.after: Long 20s Event Horizon gaps hand you repeated free all-ins: W both passes, Q, auto the third stack.

edits.before: Shadow Assault online — the roam game doubles and the all-in wraps targets in a blade carousel.
edits.after: Shadow Assault out-bursts his combo — save E to exit the cage; R rings finish what WQ starts.

edits.before: First item spike: the full string one-rotations squishies. Shove and parkour — side lanes owe you taxes.
edits.after: First item: lethality one-shots his paper health through any AP total — keep killing, starve the stacks.

edits.before: Late Talon flanks from coordinates wards don't cover: R in, string the carry, blade-exit through the wall.
edits.after: If you kept killing, his stacks never flip it — parkour the unwarded wall, R the carry, end before he ramps.

edits.before: Level 6 is Talon's: Bladeflurry out-bursts his combo when you hold E for the cage.
edits.after: Level 6 is Talon's: Shadow Assault out-bursts his combo if you hold E for the cage.

edits.before: Your Bladeflurry combo out-bursts his Baleful Strike setup. Save E to dash out of a cage wall or over terrain onto him, then R rings plus WQ kills him well before his primary-fire nuke and Event Horizon can chain.
edits.after: Your Shadow Assault (R) combo out-bursts his Baleful Strike setup. Save E to dash over terrain onto him — never through a cage wall — then R rings plus WQ kill him before Dark Matter and Event Horizon chain.

edits.before: Veigar's only defensive tool is Event Horizon on a long early cooldown (~16-18s), so every time it's down you have a free WQ all-in. Rake to slow, blink in with Noxian Diplomacy, and his low base health folds before he can stack Q.
edits.after: Veigar's only defensive tool is Event Horizon on a long early cooldown (20s at rank 1), so every time it's down you have a free WQ all-in. Rake to slow, blink in with Noxian Diplomacy, and his low base health folds before he can stack Q.

notes: spikes[1] previously advised saving E 'to dash out of a cage wall' — dashing through the cage edge stuns per the page's own correct edge-stun rule, so the rewrite routes E over terrain instead; content 'wants.you[1]' still says 'dash out of the cage', which the L-band left no room to correct further — whether Talon's E can cross Event Horizon's edge unstunned is unverified from the kits. Veigar is male; pronouns correct. All 3 lint findings addressed.
